readmeMarkdown:
# Antigravity Pilot (`antigravity-pilot`) **Cross-platform desktop computer use and `<1s` parallel virtual desktops for Google Antigravity — on Windows, macOS, and Linux, with zero MCP token bloat.** [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin%20v1.0-2563EB?style=flat-square)](plugin.json) [![Zero-MCP CLI](https://img.shields.io/badge/Architecture-Zero--MCP%20CLI-10B981?style=flat-square)](#why-hybrid-cli-instead-of-a-heavy-mcp-server) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Win%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-0F172A?style=flat-square)](#platform-support-matrix) [![Risk-Guard](https://img.shields.io/badge/Safety-Risk--Guard-F59E0B?style=flat-square)](#security-guardrails) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-334155?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [Highlights](#highlights) · [Platform Matrix](#platform-support-matrix) · [Architecture](#why-hybrid-cli-instead-of-a-heavy-mcp-server) · [Quick Start](#quick-start) · [CLI Reference](#cli-quick-reference) · [Parallel Sandboxes](#parallel-desktop-automation) · [Security](#security-guardrails)
--- > **Control any native desktop without burning thousands of context tokens on bloated MCP tool schemas.** > > **Antigravity Pilot** unites Vercel Labs **`agent-desktop`** (headless `AX` / `UIA` / `AT-SPI` accessibility trees), zero-dependency Python **`pilot_ctl.py`** (Set-of-Mark `--annotate` & `--grid` overlays, deterministic **Risk-Guard** + JSONL audit traces, multi-display `window-tile`, parameterized `recipe` workflows, and native notifications), and **`sandbox_ctl.py`** (`<1s` Docker virtual Linux desktops with live **noVNC** human-in-the-loop takeover) — backed by the autonomous **`desktop-operator`** subagent. --- ## Highlights - **Cross-Platform Headless Control (`agent-desktop`):** Drives native apps on **Windows (`UIA`)**, **macOS (`AX`)**, and **Linux (`AT-SPI`)** without stealing focus or moving the cursor, with qualified `@:e` stale-ref protection, Chromium/Electron accessibility, overlay surfaces, `wait`, `batch`, and `--stdin` secret piping. - **Zero-Dependency Set-of-Mark (`--annotate` & `--grid`):** `pilot_ctl.py screenshot` renders crisp bounding boxes, numbered interactive refs (`e1..eN`), and optional coordinate grids directly onto PNGs using pure Python standard library — giving agents reliable visual grounding on canvas, WebGL, and custom views across all three OSes. - **Deterministic Risk-Guard & JSONL Audit Traces:** `guard-check`, `safe-click`, `safe-close`, and `recipe run` deterministically block destructive or external-send actions with exit code **`2`** (`RISK_GUARD_BLOCKED`) unless `--confirm-risky` is explicitly passed after user approval. Record compact JSONL audit logs with `--trace ` or `PILOT_CTL_TRACE`. - **Parameterized Recipes & Multi-Display Tiling:** Store, inspect, `--dry-run`, and replay parameterized workflows (`--param key=val`) with `pilot_ctl.py recipe`, and snap windows across multiple monitors with `pilot_ctl.py window-tile ... --display <1-based>`. - **`<1s` Parallel Virtual Desktops + Live noVNC (`sandbox_ctl.py`):** Launch isolated Docker/Colima virtual Linux desktops (`ag-desk-*`) from Windows, macOS, or Linux with optional browser-accessible live **noVNC** (`up --vnc` + `url `) for seamless human takeover during 2FA, SSO logins, or CAPTCHAs. --- ## Platform Support Matrix | Capability | Windows 10/11 | macOS 13+ | Linux (X11 / Wayland) | Engine | | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- | | **Headless Accessibility Tree (`snapshot`, `click`, `type`, `wait`, `batch`)** | ✅ (`UIA`) | ✅ (`AX`) | ✅ (`AT-SPI`) | `agent-desktop` | | **Zero-Dep Set-of-Mark (`screenshot --annotate --grid`)** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | `pilot_ctl.py` | | **Deterministic Risk-Guard (`guard-check`, `safe-click`, `safe-close`) & JSONL Trace** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | `pilot_ctl.py` | | **Multi-Display Window Tiling (`window-tile --display `)** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | `pilot_ctl.py` | | **Parameterized Recipes (`recipe list\|show\|save\|run\|delete`)** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | `pilot_ctl.py` | | **Native Desktop Notifications (`notify`) & Readiness (`doctor`)** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | `pilot_ctl.py` | | **Parallel Virtual Linux Desktops + Live noVNC (`up --vnc`, `url`, `exec`)** | ✅ (Docker) | ✅ (Docker / Colima) | ✅ (Docker) | `sandbox_ctl.py` | | **Live Demo Recording (`record`) & Apple Shortcuts (`shortcut`)** | — | ⚡ Native Accelerator | — | `pilot_ctl.py` → `bin/macos-ctl` | > **Honest note on macOS Native Accelerators:** `record` (capturing live user mouse/keyboard demos into recipe JSON via macOS Input Monitoring) and `shortcut` (running Apple Shortcuts) are macOS-only accelerators delegated automatically through the compiled Swift binary `bin/macos-ctl`. Every other capability — including headless control, Set-of-Mark overlays, Risk-Guard, audit traces, multi-display tiling, `recipe save/run`, `notify`, and live noVNC sandboxes — runs natively on **Windows, macOS, and Linux**. --- ## Why Hybrid CLI Instead of a Heavy MCP Server? Typical desktop-control MCP servers inject **50+ tool schemas** into every conversation turn, burning thousands of context tokens before the agent even reads your prompt. **Antigravity Pilot** uses a **zero-MCP hybrid CLI stack** instead: ```mermaid flowchart LR Agent["Antigravity Agent / desktop-operator"] --> Primary["agent-desktop (AX / UIA / AT-SPI)"] Agent --> Pilot["pilot_ctl.py (Zero-Dep Python 3)"] Agent --> Sandbox["sandbox_ctl.py (Docker / Colima)"] Pilot --> SoM["Set-of-Mark --annotate & --grid"] Pilot --> Guard["Risk-Guard (exit 2) + JSONL Trace"] Pilot --> Util["window-tile · recipe · notify · macOS accel"] Sandbox --> VNC["ag-desk-* Virtual Linux Desktops + Live noVNC"] ``` 1. **Primary Engine — `agent-desktop` (Vercel Labs):** Headless-first semantic accessibility engine with qualified `@:e` refs, Chromium/Electron support, overlay surfaces, `wait`, `batch`, `--stdin` secret piping, and built-in `POLICY_DENIED` quit guards. 2. **Complement Engine — `pilot_ctl.py` (Zero-Dep Python 3):** Cross-platform Set-of-Mark rendering, deterministic Risk-Guard + JSONL trace logging, multi-display window tiling, parameterized recipes, native notifications, and seamless macOS Swift acceleration (`bin/macos-ctl`). 3. **Virtual Desktop Engine — `sandbox_ctl.py`:** Launches `<1s` isolated virtual Linux desktops (`antigravity-desktop-sandbox:latest`, prefix `ag-desk-*`) with optional live **noVNC** so parallel subagents never fight over host focus, cursor, or clipboard. 4. **Autonomous Subagent — `desktop-operator`:** Runs multi-step *Observe → Act → Verify* loops in an isolated subagent context with hard safety stops, keeping your main conversation clean. --- ## Quick Start ### Prerequisites - **Python 3.9+** (standard library only — zero `pip` dependencies required for `pilot_ctl.py` and `sandbox_ctl.py`) - **Vercel Labs `agent-desktop`** on your `PATH` (installed or verified by the installer) - **Docker** or **Colima** (optional — only needed for Level 2 parallel virtual desktops via `sandbox_ctl.py`) - **macOS optional:** Xcode Command Line Tools (`swift`) if compiling the native `bin/macos-ctl` accelerator for `record` and `shortcut` ### macOS & Linux (Bash / Zsh) ```bash git clone https://github.com/Aphygo/antigravity-pilot.git \ "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-pilot" cd "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-pilot" ./scripts/install.sh ``` ### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Aphygo/antigravity-pilot.git ` "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-pilot" cd "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-pilot" .\scripts\install.ps1 ``` ### Verify Permissions & Readiness **macOS & Linux:** ```bash agent-desktop permissions python3 "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-pilot/scripts/pilot_ctl.py" doctor ``` *(If macOS Accessibility or Screen Recording is missing, run `agent-desktop permissions --guide`.)* **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell agent-desktop status python "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-pilot\scripts\pilot_ctl.py" doctor ``` --- ## CLI Quick Reference ### `pilot_ctl.py` (Cross-Platform Complement CLI) Run via `python3 "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-pilot/scripts/pilot_ctl.py"` (or `bin/pilot-ctl` on macOS/Linux) or `python "%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-pilot\scripts\pilot_ctl.py"` on Windows. | Command | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | | `doctor [--json]` | Inspect OS backend, `agent-desktop`, permissions, Docker, and macOS accelerator status. | | `screenshot [--app ] [--window-id ] [--screen ] [--annotate] [--grid] [--max-depth ] [--limit ] [--session ] [--agent-id ] [--json]` | Zero-dependency screenshot with Set-of-Mark (`--annotate`) interactive bounding boxes/refs and/or coordinate `--grid`. | | `window-tile [--window-id ] [--title ] [--display <1-based>] [--json]` | Snap an app window to halves, centered, or maximized layout on a chosen display. | | `guard-check [--json]` | Check whether an action/target trips deterministic Risk-Guard (exit `2` + `RISK_GUARD_BLOCKED`). | | `safe-click [--label ] [--app ] [--headed]` | Click a qualified ref through Risk-Guard enforcement. | | `safe-close [--force]` | Close an app cleanly through Risk-Guard (`--force` requires `--confirm-risky`). | | `recipe list\|show\|save\|run\|delete` | Manage and execute parameterized recipes (`--param key=val`, `--dry-run`, `--stdin`, `--confirm-risky`). | | `notify <message>` | Show a native desktop notification on Windows, macOS, or Linux. | | `record [--duration <sec>] [--output <file>] [--app <name>]` | *(macOS accelerator)* Record live mouse/keyboard demos into recipe JSON. | | `shortcut <name> [--input <text>]` | *(macOS accelerator)* Run an Apple Shortcut by name. | **Global flags:** `--confirm-risky` (only after explicit user approval) and `--trace <file.jsonl>` (or environment variable `PILOT_CTL_TRACE=<file.jsonl>`). --- ## Parallel Desktop Automation `antigravity-pilot` supports two complementary levels of parallelism: ### Level 1 — Host Multi-Worker Sessions (`agent-desktop`) Isolate concurrent workers on the host desktop with `--session` and `--agent-id`: ```bash agent-desktop --session batch-1 --agent-id worker-a \ snapshot --app "Google Chrome" --window-id w-101 -i --compact agent-desktop --session batch-1 --agent-id worker-b \ snapshot --app "Google Chrome" --window-id w-205 -i --compact ``` > **Multi-window gotcha:** On multi-window apps like Chrome, Edge, Finder, or Explorer, always pass `--app "<App>"` and `--window-id <id>` together so each worker stays pinned to its intended window. ### Level 2 — Parallel Virtual Desktops + Live noVNC (`sandbox_ctl.py`) When parallel agents need fully isolated displays, clipboards, and application state across Windows, macOS, or Linux, run virtual Linux desktops in Docker/Colima (`antigravity-desktop-sandbox:latest`, container prefix `ag-desk-*`): ```bash # macOS / Linux (on Windows, invoke with: python scripts\sandbox_ctl.py ...) SANDBOX="python3 $HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-pilot/scripts/sandbox_ctl.py" # 1. Build the sandbox image once (add --with-chromium for browser workflows) $SANDBOX build --with-chromium # 2. Spin up isolated virtual desktops (<1s each), optionally with live noVNC $SANDBOX up desk-1 --vnc --vnc-port 6081 $SANDBOX up desk-2 # 3. Get the live noVNC URL for human-in-the-loop takeover (e.g. 2FA / login) $SANDBOX url desk-1 # 4. Run agent-desktop commands inside each virtual desktop $SANDBOX exec desk-1 status $SANDBOX exec desk-2 snapshot -i --compact # 5. Inspect or tear down sandboxes $SANDBOX list --json $SANDBOX down desk-1 $SANDBOX down-all ``` --- ## Security Guardrails Both the always-on rules (`rules/AGENTS.md`) and the `desktop-operator` subagent (`agents/desktop-operator.md`) enforce hard safety boundaries: - **Headless by default:** Semantic accessibility calls never steal focus or move the cursor unless `--headed` is explicitly required and permitted. - **Deterministic Risk-Guard (`RISK_GUARD_BLOCKED`, exit `2`):** `pilot_ctl.py` blocks destructive and external-send actions before execution; `--confirm-risky` is never passed without explicit user approval. - **JSONL Audit Trace:** Record compact machine-readable logs of every `pilot_ctl.py` action via `--trace <file.jsonl>` or `PILOT_CTL_TRACE`. - **Built-in `POLICY_DENIED` guards:** Dangerous quit/delete key combinations are blocked by default in `agent-desktop`; use `close-app` or `pilot_ctl.py safe-close` instead. - **Safe retry semantics:** Actions are retried **only** when `error.disposition.retry == "safe"` (`delivery == "not_delivered"`), preventing accidental double-submits. - **Secrets off argv:** Sensitive or multiline text is always piped via `--stdin`. - **Hard approval stops:** Destructive actions (deleting files/records, emptying Trash/Recycle Bin, closing unsaved work), external sends/publishing, financial/legal commitments, and credential/OS security changes always pause for explicit user confirmation. --- ## Repository Structure ```text antigravity-pilot/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest (v1.0.0) ├── README.md # Documentation & platform matrix ├── LICENSE # Apache License 2.0 ├── assets/ │ ├── hero.svg # Repository hero banner │ └── logo.svg # Plugin icon ├── rules/ │ └── AGENTS.md # Always-on cross-platform rules & guardrails ├── skills/ │ └── desktop-computer-use/ │ └── SKILL.md # Full cross-platform command & workflow reference ├── agents/ │ └── desktop-operator.md # Autonomous multi-step GUI subagent ├── scripts/ │ ├── pilot_ctl.py # Zero-dep cross-platform complement CLI │ ├── sandbox_ctl.py # Cross-platform Docker/noVNC sandbox manager │ ├── install.sh # macOS & Linux installer │ └── install.ps1 # Windows PowerShell installer ├── bin/ │ ├── pilot-ctl # macOS/Linux wrapper for pilot_ctl.py │ ├── sandbox-ctl # macOS/Linux wrapper for sandbox_ctl.py │ └── macos-ctl # Optional compiled macOS Swift accelerator ├── src/ # Swift source for optional macOS accelerator ├── sandbox/ # Dockerfile & scripts for virtual Linux desktops └── tests/ # Automated smoke & cross-platform regression tests ``` --- ## Credits & License - Built on top of **[Vercel Labs `agent-desktop`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-desktop)**, licensed under the **Apache License 2.0**. - Architectural inspiration from **`ghost-os`** (self-learning recipes), **`Peekaboo`** (Set-of-Mark visual grounding), **`virtual-desktop`** (containerized noVNC sandboxes), and **`macos-computer-use-kit`** (deterministic guardrails & tracing). - **Antigravity Pilot (`antigravity-pilot`)** by **Aphygo** is licensed under the **Apache License 2.0** — see [LICENSE](LICENSE) for full terms.
